claims.statement: The repository implements tested synthetic research controls for provenance, gating, uncertainty accounting, custody declarations, and local audit bundles.
claims.limitation: This supports a software-control claim only; it does not validate plasma-wake physics or demonstrate on-orbit detection.

claims.statement: The project has demonstrated physically valid plasma-wake detection performance.
claims.limitation: No physics-capable forward model or independent validation evidence has been admitted.

claims.statement: The project has observed and identified an orbital-debris plasma wake.
claims.limitation: No approved observed Heimdall instrument data, time alignment, independent review, or scientific validation exists.

claims.statement: The project may inform collision avoidance, maneuvering, or safety decisions.
claims.limitation: This research foundation is not an operational safety system and has no maneuver authority.
